# Same prompt, two models: side-by-side comparison videos with time and cost

**Two runs of one prompt become a side-by-side or stacked video with each model's measured time and cost, optionally blind until the reveal.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/4325c578-378d-4c43-ae53-3cc3218df1ea/file_2e1850a6570d.webp" alt="Split-screen comparison: the same Blender forest scene rendered by Eevee and by Cycles side by side, each labelled with seconds per frame and total render time." width="480"></p>

Make the "same prompt, two models" comparison video that every model launch produces (Claude Fable 5.2 vs Opus 5.5, Seedance vs Kling, Eevee vs Cycles): run one prompt twice under the same rules, log the real time and cost of each run, then lay the two results side by side (1920×1080) or stacked (1080×1920), started on the same frame, each with its name and its time and cost under it, optionally blind ("A" and "B" until the last seconds, then the reveal) and with a winner frame. scripts/split.py does the layout with ffmpeg and Pillow, so it works with an ffmpeg built without drawtext. Use when someone asks for a model comparison video, "Fable vs Opus", "same prompt two models", a side-by-side or split-screen comparison with cost and time, a blind "guess which one" test, or A/B of two renders or two edits. Not for a split screen inside a story edit (varg-video-edit-library), comparing many models in a grid of stills (gpt-image-2-6), or making the clips themselves (blender-code-film, code-game-trailer, varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill model-split-screen                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills model-split-screen --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 82 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 1920×1080 or 1080×1920 MP4 with names, stats, optional blind reveal and winner frame |
| Needs | nothing paid: runs locally |
| Typical cost | free locally: a 9 s 1080p split in under 2 s (measured) |
| Uses | Python, Pillow, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Lay out ./fable.mp4 and ./opus.mp4 side by side with their time and cost: Fable 1 h 57 min $81.10, Opus 3 h 11 min $45.97"
- "Make a 9:16 blind A/B of these two renders and reveal the names in the last 3 seconds"
- "Run this prompt in two fresh sessions, log time and cost, then make the comparison video"
